Translation goal: reverse-translatability for the Tafsir reader — readers should be able to map English back to JA. Saadia-specific moves preserved per data-source/saadia-gloss-table.json; Blau's notes (data-source/blau-genesis-notes.json) consulted for Bereshit 1-12.

translations.1: Then God said to Moses: 'Hew out two tablets of gemstone like the first ones, so that I may write upon them all the words which were upon the first two tablets — those that you broke.'
translations.2: And be ready for the morning; and ascend in the morning to Mount Sinai, and stand there before Me upon the summit of the mountain.
translations.3: And no person shall ascend with you, and no person shall be seen in any part of the mountain; even the flocks and the herds shall not graze in what is adjacent to it.'
translations.4: So he hewed out two tablets of gemstone like the first ones; and Moses rose early before sunrise and ascended to Mount Sinai, as God had commanded him; and he took with him the two tablets of gemstone.
translations.5: And God appeared in the cloud, and set His light with him there; and He called out in the name of God.
translations.6: And when the light of God passed before him, God called out: 'God! God! — the Able, the Merciful, the Compassionate, long of forbearance, abundant in grace and goodness,
translations.7: keeping grace unto thousands, forgiving iniquity and transgression and sin — and He pardons, yet does not pardon — requiring the iniquities of the fathers together with the sons, and with the third and fourth generations.'
translations.8: And Moses hastened, and fell upon the ground and bowed down.
translations.9: He said: 'If I have found favor with You, O Lord, let Your light travel among us — for they are a people stiff of neck; so forgive our iniquities and our sins, and choose us as Your own.'
translations.10: He said: 'Behold, I am making a covenant — before all your people I shall perform wonders the like of which have not been created in all the world nor among the nations; and all the people in whose midst you are shall behold the work of God, that it is awesome — that which I am doing with you.
translations.11: Keep what I am commanding you this day: behold, I am driving out from before you the Amorites and the Canaanites and the Hittites and the Perizzites and the Hivites and the Jebusites.
translations.12: Take heed lest you make a covenant with the inhabitants of the land to which you are going, lest they become a snare in your midst.
translations.13: Rather, their altars — pull them down; and their pillars — break them; and their cultic-posts you shall cut off.
translations.14: And you shall not bow down to any other object of worship; for God — His name is 'the Punisher,' and He has the power to punish.
translations.15: Lest you make a covenant with the inhabitants of the land, and they transgress in following after their objects of worship and sacrifice to them, and they invite you, and you eat of their sacrifice;
translations.16: and you wed your sons from their daughters, and their daughters transgress in following after their objects of worship, and they lead your sons astray as well.
translations.17: And a cast object of worship — do not make for yourself.
translations.18: The festival of unleavened bread — keep it; seven days you shall eat unleavened bread as I have commanded you, at the time of the month of the barley-harvest, for in it you went out from Egypt.
translations.19: Every firstborn of the womb belongs to Me; and whatever male your livestock brings forth, from the firstborn of the cattle and of the flocks.
translations.20: And the firstborn of the donkeys — redeem it with a ewe-lamb; and if you do not redeem it, then slaughter it by the neck. And all the firstborn males of your sons — redeem them; and they shall not appear before Me empty.
translations.21: Six days you shall labor, and on the seventh day you shall rest — even at the time of plowing and of harvest, you shall rest.
translations.22: And the festival of weeks — observe it for yourself, at the time of the first of the wheat harvest; and the festival of the ingathering, at the end of the year.
translations.23: Three times in the year shall all your men appear before the Lord God, the God of Israel.
translations.24: For I shall cut off nations from before you, and I shall widen your territory; and no one shall seize anything from your land when you ascend to appear before God your Lord — three times in the year.
translations.25: You shall not slaughter My Passover-offering over leaven; and you shall not leave over the fat of My festival-offering until the morning.
translations.26: The choicest firstfruits of your land — bring them to the house of the sanctuary of God your Lord; and you shall not eat flesh with milk.'
translations.27: And God said to Moses: 'Write down for yourself this word, for by means of it I have made this covenant with you and with the sons of Israel.'
translations.28: And he remained there before God forty days and forty nights; he ate no food and drank no water; and He wrote for him upon the two tablets the words of the covenant — they being the Ten Words.
translations.29: And when Moses descended from Mount Sinai, with the two tablets of the testimony in his hand as he descended from the mountain — Moses did not know that the light of his face had begun to radiate when God had spoken with him.
translations.30: And Aaron and the rest of the sons of Israel saw Moses — and behold, the light of his face was radiating; and they were afraid to approach him.
translations.31: Until Moses called to them; and Aaron and the rest of the nobles of the assembly returned to him, and Moses spoke with them.
translations.32: And after that, the rest of the sons of Israel drew near; and he commanded them all that God had spoken with him on Mount Sinai.
translations.33: And when Moses had finished speaking with them, he placed a veil over his face.
translations.34: And Moses, whenever he entered before God to receive His address, would remove the veil until his departure; then he would go out and speak to the sons of Israel all that he was commanded.
translations.35: So that the sons of Israel would see Moses' face — that the light of his face was radiating; then he would put the veil back upon his face, until the time of his entering to receive His address.
